Set CDC Locator API credentials for this session

Source: R/auth.R
cdc_locator_set_credentials.Rd

Sets the CDC_LOCATOR_CLIENT_ID and CDC_LOCATOR_CLIENT_TOKEN environment variables for the current R session, so the other functions can find them. The values are never printed, and no file is written.

Usage

cdc_locator_set_credentials(client_id, client_token)

Arguments

client_id

Your Locator API client ID, a single string.

client_token

Your Locator API client token, a single string.

Value

NULL, invisibly. Called for its side effect of setting the two environment variables.

Details

To keep the credentials between sessions, add both variables to your .Renviron file instead, for example with usethis::edit_r_environ(), and restart R:

CDC_LOCATOR_CLIENT_ID=your-client-id
CDC_LOCATOR_CLIENT_TOKEN=your-client-token

Avoid typing the token into a script you might share. Calling this function with values read from a password manager, or with rstudioapi::askForPassword(), keeps them out of your code.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
cdc_locator_set_credentials(
  client_id = "your-client-id",
  client_token = "your-client-token"
)
} # }
